page.overview:
Who is Amariya Cormoray?

Lady Amariya Dacen Cormoray is a member of House Cormoray. As an NPC, she is played by Brennan Lee Mulligan.

Amariya is a "very bejeweled" middle-aged woman with dark skin, hair wrapped in braided rings like a crown set with gold, and dressed in resplendent white robes with long ivory fingernails painted white to match her gown..}}

She was professional and polite when speaking to a new acquaintance. However, she was also prideful and daring regarding her position and her knowledge and understanding of things.

Amariya was a member of House Cormoray of the Sundered Houses and, as others in her bloodline, manifested powerful sorcerous abilities. At some she married Lord Dacen. During or shortly before the beginning of Campaign Four, she was appointed by the Chamber of Lords-Advisory to represent them in specific tasks.
